body:
Currently, row_filter expressions involving a boolean expression fail. This pull adds in the already-defined boolean literals as part of the list of parsed literals.
In addition, identifiers can now be defined with double quotes (") as part of the SQL spec.
title: Add support for boolean expressions and quoted columns

Bumps duckdb from 1.1.0 to 1.1.3.

Release notes
Sourced from duckdb's releases.

v1.1.3 Bugfix Release
This is a bug fix release for various issues discovered after we released 1.1.2. There are no new major features, just bug fixes. Database files created by DuckDB versions all the way back to v0.9.* can be read by this version.
What's Changed

[Adaptive Sniffer] In case files have only one row, be more permissive to detect headers and types. by @​pdet in duckdb/duckdb#14174
Increase bounds for test/sql/copy/file_size_bytes.test by @​lnkuiper in duckdb/duckdb#14367
Use table-level locking when acquiring shared locks by @​ywelsch in duckdb/duckdb#14370
[Arrow] Fix scanning of BOOL columns when offsets are involved by @​Tishj in duckdb/duckdb#14395
avoid unnecessary file list materialization when pruning readers by @​samansmink in duckdb/duckdb#14397
Fixing type pushdown on the CSV Scanner by @​pdet in duckdb/duckdb#14399
Issue #14398: Lead Shift Defaults by @​hawkfish in duckdb/duckdb#14409
Escape should default to quoted by @​pdet in duckdb/duckdb#14418
Sniff CSV rejects options and small sniffer fix for ignore_errors by @​pdet in duckdb/duckdb#14417
Fix #14430 - throw an error when reading corrupt statistics in the perfect hash aggregate by @​Mytherin in duckdb/duckdb#14442
Use corrent container to produce BinderErrors by @​carlopi in duckdb/duckdb#14437
Rework list_concat to accept a variable number of arguments similar to string concat by @​Mytherin in duckdb/duckdb#14443
SingleFileBlockManager::MarkBlockAsUsed - also erase from newly_freed_list to ensure trim does not prune blocks that are in-use by @​Mytherin in duckdb/duckdb#14467
acosh: Change example to avoid returning NaN by @​szarnyasg in duckdb/duckdb#14477
Don't move lvalue when inserting in order preserving map by @​Maxxen in duckdb/duckdb#14492
bump vss by @​Maxxen in duckdb/duckdb#14493

Python 3.7 tests are particularly brittle, we will keep building wheels but avoid testing them by @​carlopi in duckdb/duckdb#14510
Being more restrictive with the names option in the csv reader by @​pdet in duckdb/duckdb#14466
[Arrow] Fix issue where uninitialized memory was being read when scanning empty lists by @​Tishj in duckdb/duckdb#14538
Fix #14545 - pivot header must be defined in the grammar by @​Mytherin in duckdb/duckdb#14556

[Dev] Include aliases for RETURNING list expressions in ToString by @​Tishj in duckdb/duckdb#14533
CI: Mirror 'reproduced' / 'under review' to the internal repository by @​szarnyasg in duckdb/duckdb#14527
Approx-Top K: Make aggregate state trivially destructible by @​Mytherin in duckdb/duckdb#14571
Don't pre-initialize hash vector in DistinctStatistics construction by @​abramk in duckdb/duckdb#14570
Fix query_graph tool for #14290 by @​JasonPunyon in duckdb/duckdb#14521
Fix typos by @​deining in duckdb/duckdb#14579
[Dev] Traverse the replace_list of StarExpression in ParsedExpressionIterator::EnumerateChildren by @​Tishj in duckdb/duckdb#14535
chore: Add EOL to source files by @​krlmlr in duckdb/duckdb#14583
Issue template: Add Swift redirect by @​szarnyasg in duckdb/duckdb#14588
Fix for underflow issue on number of rows in the CSV Reader by @​pdet in duckdb/duckdb#14587

* CloudFormation now supports the types AWS::IoT::Thing, AWS::IoT::ThingType, AWS::IoT::Policy
* EC2: Key Pairs now use the correct algorithm to calculate the fingerprint
* ELBv2: modify_lb_attr() now supports zonal-shift config
* ECS: create_task_set() now actually creates tasks
* Lambda: The MOTO_DOCKER_LAMBDA_IMAGE config option now accepts full image names, including the tag
* Lambda: Events send to DynamoDB now have the correct eventName
* Organizations: describe_organization() now describes the parent account (if applicable)
* WAFv2: create_web_acl() now supports additional parameters (AssociationConfig, CaptchaConfig, ChallengeConfig, CustomResponseBodies, TokenDomains)
* WAFv2: delete_web_acl() now supports the LockToken-parameter
* WAFv2: update_web_acl() now supports additional parameters (LockToken, AssociationConfig, CaptchaConfig, ChallengeConfig, CustomResponseBodies, TokenDomains)
